evals.prompt: I have a file at ~/Downloads/Q4-board-deck.pptx and I want it converted to Markdown so I can feed it into an LLM. Save the output next to the deck, and tell me exactly what you ran.
evals.expected_output: Uses Docling CLI for a one-off PPTX, passes an output directory beside the deck, and reports the exact command and expected output filename.

evals.prompt: My 40-page scanned PDF has poor extracted text. Convert pages 5 through 12 into Markdown, preserve tables where possible, and explain the first escalation if default OCR is not enough.
evals.expected_output: Uses bounded Docling PDF conversion with --page-range, recognizes default OCR/tables, and proposes an explicit OCR/pipeline escalation rather than claiming perfect fidelity.

evals.prompt: I need semantic Markdown and a separate PNG for every original page of this PDF. Can Docling do both?
evals.expected_output: Uses Docling for Markdown, correctly distinguishes referenced document images from original page PNGs, and selects pdftocairo/pdftoppm for per-page rendering.

evals.prompt: Please extract a YouTube URL to Markdown without adding a heavyweight PDF pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Routes the special case to isolated MarkItDown via uvx rather than claiming Docling handles YouTube URLs.
